auth.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Set up your organization in under a minute.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper and lower case letters and a number.
register.checkEmailBody: We sent a verification link to your inbox. Click it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, we sent a password reset link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper and lower case letters and a number.
reset.missingToken: This link is missing its token. Request a new reset link.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.noToken: Open the verification link from your email to activate your account. Didn't get it? We can send a new one.
verify.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
verify.sent: If that address has an unverified account, a new verification link is on its way. Check your spam folder too.

invitation.notFound: This invitation link is invalid, expired, or has already been used. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
invitation.intro: You've been invited to join {organization} on Mediaory as a {role}. Set up your account to accept.
invitation.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper and lower case letters and a number.

federated.title: Login methods
federated.help: Use your account to sign in. Only identity and email are requested; no YouTube, files or repository access.
federated.linkHelp: Connect a login method to your signed-in Mediaory account. Existing accounts are never merged by matching email alone.
federated.existing: Sign in with your existing method first, then connect this provider in Settings → Login methods.
federated.verify: Verify your Mediaory email before signing in.
federated.failed: The connection could not be completed. Please try again.

track.title: What do you want to track?

keywords.title: Add keywords to track
keywords.placeholder: e.g. Lunavera Teknoloji, new product launch
keywords.label: Keyword
keywords.help: Separate keywords with commas. A keyword can be a single word or a whole phrase, and is searched exactly as you write it.
keywords.empty: Try your company name, a product, or an executive's name.

sources.title: Choose sources
sources.scopeHelp: This selects source types, not access to every platform or all its content. You can adjust countries and coverage later from Monitoring.

instant.label: Every new story
instant.desc: An alert in the app whenever new stories match. Expect a lot.

high_priority_only.label: Important stories only
high_priority_only.desc: An alert only when a story that matters appears — not for every mention.

daily_digest.label: Daily digest
daily_digest.desc: No alerts. One summary e-mail a day, with the most important stories first.

weekly_summary.label: Weekly archive
weekly_summary.desc: No alerts. The weekly archive e-mail, with everything found that week.

project.title: Name this project
project.label: Project name
project.summary: Tracking {keywords, plural, one {# keyword} other {# keywords}} across {sources, plural, one {# source type} other {# source types}}.

onboarding.intro: Choose a topic, select your source coverage and set your notification preference.
onboarding.firstResults: We first look for matches in stored stories; new results arrive as sources are checked. If nothing matches, try a distinctive name or another phrase. We never add sample results.

sourceCoverage.title: Source coverage for your monitoring
sourceCoverage.counts: {total} sources: {healthy} healthy, {attention} delayed or needing attention, {paused} paused.
sourceCoverage.geography: The catalog includes {countries} countries and {languages} languages.
sourceCoverage.noActive: No active sources match this scope. Review your monitoring coverage.
sourceCoverage.help: Current source status matching the types and regions of your active monitoring. The latest check does not mean every source is fresh or every story will match. Paused sources are not crawled.
